title: Gravitational Sensors and the Structure of the Gravitational Field in Six Dimensions of Space and Time
content: Möbius gravitational field detectors convert gravitational field turbulence into electric pulses based on the interaction between electromagnetism and gravity in six-dimensional spacetime. The gravitational field is a hypercone in six-dimensional spacetime with distinct geometric layers based on field density. No interaction between gravity and electromagnetism has been recorded in previous studies. Electromagnetic waves in time loops convert into gravitational fields, and variations of the gravitational field in Möbius sensors transform into electric currents. The results include studies on Möbius sensors, electric current generators from gravitational fields, gravitational radars, warp engines, and earthquake prediction.
